_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::multiscale#0. The cost claim is right and its Signal is wrong. There is no MicroSolver timer — the string appears zero times in the run's output, and no timer in the TimeMonitor table mentions micro at all — because every RVE solve is counted into the same generic 'Core::LinAlg::Solver: 2) Solve' entry as the macro solves. So the profile cannot attribute the time, which is the opposite of what the entry promised. What is visible is the call count: upstream sohex8_multiscale_macro performs 1.326e+04 linear solves on a tiny macro mesh, and the identical mesh and schedule with the three MAT_Struct_Multiscale materials swapped for a plain MAT_Struct_StVenantKirchhoff performs 10. Both arms have RESULT DESCRIPTION stripped so both reach the timer table; 4C aborts before printing it when a result test fails. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology: leave the multiscale materials in the 'plain' arm too. Both arms then do the same 1.326e+04 solves, the contrast disappears and PLAIN_SOLVE_CALLS no longer reads 10, so the fixture must go red.
